(Capacity: 3,500) |champion = [[2023–24 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC regular season]] & [[2024 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|tournament]] champions |tourney= [[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result= First round }} {{2023–24 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2023–24 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team''' represented [[Saint Mary's College of California]] during the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by head coach [[Randy Bennett]] in his 23rd season at Saint Mary's. The Gaels played their home games at the [[University Credit Union Pavilion]]{{efn|Formerly known as McKeon Pavilion}} in [[Moraga, California]], as members of the [[West Coast Conference]] (WCC). They finished the season 26–8, 15–1 in [[2023–24 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC play]] to win the regular season championship. As the No. 1 seed in the WCC tournament, they defeated [[2023–24 Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball team|Santa Clara]] in the semifinals and beat [[2023–24 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] in the championship to win the WCC tournament. Therefore, they received an automatic bid to the NCAA tournament, where, as the No. 5 seed in the West region, they were upset in the first round by [[2023–24 Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball team|Grand Canyon]]. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Gaels]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 27–8, 14–2 in [[2022–23 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC play]], to win the WCC regular season championship with [[2022–23 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]]. In the [[2023 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]], they defeated [[2022–23 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]] in the semifinals before losing to Gonzaga in the championship. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 5 seed in the West region. There they defeated [[2022–23 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]] in the first round before losing to national champion [[2022–23 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]] in the second round. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
